limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Filtration dependence of algebraic entropy and linear reindexing effects are prior work and are not claimed as new. The corrected source is the very recent v1 preprint arXiv:2609.18144, so an author revision or concurrent independent observation may supersede this record. The full text of the Krause-Lenagan proposition cited by that preprint was not directly inspected; the counterexamples here are self-contained and address the theorem statements as printed. Fresh independent audit found the mathematics correct but scientifically superseded by stronger published results; the package is retained as a failed attempt.
provenance: Scientific sources, prior assessments, and verification evidence are documented in the package.
